final: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.ID = p.ID AND u."U-PRO" = '-') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = p.ID AND r.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_HCT DESC LIMIT 10
